verdict.rationale: Feitian's own docs list a guide for using its FIDO security keys with OpenSSH to reach GitHub and Linux servers, so hardware-backed SSH keys are a documented first-party capability. That evidence is only a single index-page blurb. PIV is documented only for SK Manager, macOS smart-card logon and digital signatures, not for SSH. Missing for 10: explicit sk-ssh (ed25519-sk/ecdsa-sk) key details, documentation that a physical touch is required at server login, PIV- or OpenPGP-based SSH support, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, my SSH keys can be hardware-backed on the device — via FIDO2 sk-ssh keys, PIV, or OpenPGP — so server access requires a physical touch

citations.quote: Learn how to apply FEITIAN FIDO security keys with OpenSSH connections including remotely connecting Github and Linux server.
